title: NOTORIETY IS SAID ONCE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD and never repeats what is already on screen. A notoriety point said a sentence with the new total in the feed while his notoriety stamp and the NOTORIETY +1 label over the body already said it. The sentence is gone for a peaceful pillager, the unarmed Survivor and the Peddler. Helping a Survivor now says NOTORIETY DOWN TO and the new number.
now: A notoriety point is shown by the stamp and the label only, and helping a Survivor says NOTORIETY DOWN TO and the number.
